mesEquipment.desc: The high-energy optical powerhouse behind High-NA EUV lithography. Housed in the B1 subfab utility basement, this multi-stage pulsed CO2 laser amplifier fires high-frequency laser pulses into molten tin droplets in the scanner chamber above to generate 13.5nm extreme ultraviolet radiation.
mesEquipment.locationDesc: Installed in the B1 subfab optical laser vault directly beneath the High-NA EUV Scanner #1, connected via vertical beam transport conduit.
mesEquipment.name: Trumpf Pulsed CO2 Drive Laser Vault (High-NA EUV)

specs.Beam Delivery: Evacuated optical transport tube penetrating to L1 scanner
specs.Cooling Medium: Process Cooling Water (PCW) 450 L/min closed loop
